title: Country Marble Survival Race ⚠️ Heat 5/7 – 27 Countries, 13 Survive
description:
Flagball Arena · Season 1, Round 1 · Heat 5/7: 27 countries race through 3 stages — only 13 survive and go to Round 2.

Countries in this heat: Australia, Austria, Belarus, Burundi, Egypt, Equatorial Guinea, Eritrea, Gambia, Georgia, Haiti, Honduras, Israel, Italy, Jordan, Latvia, Marshall Islands, Mauritius, Monaco, Mozambique, Peru, Philippines, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Serbia, Solomon Islands, Switzerland, Tanzania.

Countries still in the game before this race: 137 of 193.
Next race: Round 1 · Heat 6/7. Grand Final: Nov 9.

How it works: all 193 countries race in heats → Round 2 → Semi-finals → Grand Final, then a new season starts. 3 new races every day.

Like 👍 if your country survived and write in the comments who you're cheering for!
